source_image: image/บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_17/บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_17_หน้า18.png
view_title: แบบขยายประตู (2 แบบ) + แบบขยายหน้าต่าง (3 แบบ) + แบบขยายผนังคอนกรีตบล็อคระบายอากาศ D.1, D.2
warnings: The sheet numbers doors and windows with two independently-restarting hexagon marks (ประตู ⬡1-⬡2, หน้าต่าง ⬡1-⬡3). Relabeled to D1-D2 / W1-W3 per the D/W scheme houses 01-05 already use for this exact sheet family (recorded there as a deliberate relabeling too) — a bare '1' would collide across the two groups on one sheet (§0.3).

⚠ Near-collision to keep straight: the two ventilation-block panels carry PRINTED marks 'D.1' and 'D.2' (with a dot) — those are kept verbatim and are NOT the same ids as the relabeled doors D1/D2. The dot is the only distinguisher; both spellings are faithful to their sources (D.1/D.2 printed, D1/D2 relabeled-by-precedent).

W3 is the gable vent (ช่องแสงไม้ติดตาย) — its width is printed '0.55 + 0.55' with 'VARIES' and its height ~1.00/0.60 referenced to ระดับหลังอกไก่; recorded as printed, not resolved to a single number.
